title: Cross-network playback reliability update
notes: Fixes channels spinning indefinitely on home networks that advertise unusable IPv6 routes. Stream playback now prefers IPv4 while retaining IPv6 as a fallback, and a 20-second startup watchdog replaces endless buffering with a useful retryable error. The APK remains self-contained with the organised 25,398-channel playlist and guide, and preserves existing favourites, folders, settings, add-ons and logins.
